# Toronto Birthday Parties

> A hand-curated directory of kids birthday party venues across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada. 92 venues verified for real birthday party packages — indoor playgrounds, trampoline parks, laser tag, amusement centres, VR arcades and children's entertainers — searchable by city. Free for parents; each listing links directly to the venue.

- [All cities](https://www.torontobirthdayparties.com/birthday-party-venues)

## How listings are curated

Every venue is verified by checking its own website for real birthday party packages and reading its Google reviews (including how often recent reviews mention kids). Each venue page shows its rating, review count, package pricing when published, and a kid-fit balloon rating with the honest basis for the score. Listings that can no longer be verified are removed. The full catalogue is re-verified monthly.

## For venue owners

Listings are free. To add, update or remove a venue, use the contact page. Each venue page links out to the venue's own website and Google Maps listing.
